wins: Consistently extracted 60 reward metrics across the single episode, indicating reliable execution of reconnaissance phase (run_20260218_094641_eaa8ea_ep001_step05).
Reached high-fidelity telemetry during initial scanning, allowing clear mapping of perimeter services before escalation attempts (run_20260218_094641_eaa8ea_ep001_step12).
fails: Zero percent success rate—did not achieve final objective despite sustained reward, indicating inability to transition from initial foothold to exploitation (run_20260218_094641_eaa8ea_ep001_step20).
Required 10 mentor calls, highlighting repeated procedural uncertainty and inefficient automation handoffs (run_20260218_094641_eaa8ea_ep001_step08).
key_outcomes.summary: Good reconnaissance consistency, but the workflow stalled before delivering a successful compromise; need to augment exploitation tactics and reduce reliance on mentor guidance.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Cannot complete exploitation phase after enumeration; foothold remains untested despite evidence of vulnerable services.

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial nmap scan shows TCP 22 open with an SSH banner
skill_cards.then_action: Run nmap --script sshv1,ssh-auth-methods -p 22 and capture results for logged-in account enumeration

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service presents versioned headers with potential CMS indicators
skill_cards.then_action: Launch nikto and dirb scans to enumerate web content, then correlate results with known CVEs

skill_cards.if_condition: When reconnaissance yields clear service banners but no immediate exploit path
skill_cards.then_action: Validate captured info against known exploit templates (Metasploit module or custom script) before attempting credential brute-force

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in identifying actionable SSH targets and reducing blind credential attempts.

next_experiments.title: Exploit Validation Chain
next_experiments.description: Automate correlation of enumeration outputs (SSH banners, HTTP headers) with specific exploit modules, then trigger low-risk proof-of-concept attempts to verify kill-chain progression.

next_experiments.title: Mentor Call Reduction
next_experiments.description: Integrate decision-tree prompts for exploitation phase to reduce reliance on mentor input, focusing on deterministic action plans once enumeration data is available.

next_experiments.title: Post-Enumeration Persistence Trials
next_experiments.description: After confirmed service vulnerabilities, deploy automated post-exploit tasks (e.g., ls, whoami, persistent shell setup) to ensure repetition builds consistent foothold.
